concept.reason: Author skeletal reconstruction and original skull photograph with tooth measurements suffice; no extra concept rendering.

scope: Whole terrestrial predator with proportionately large elongated head, readable shearing cheek teeth and long balancing tail.

scientific_limits.en: 2022 Fig1B is a skeletal reconstruction reproduced from Scott and Jepsen, normalized by thorax length, not an absolute scale or one confirmed complete specimen.2011 Fig8 caption gives25cm skull length but no explicit catalog identification in caption; do not equate it with SDSM3017 or493. Named tooth measurements are distinct source specimens. Full body dimensions, skin, ears, tail soft tissues and color are restoration estimates. Never scale giant Asian species or modern hyena body proportions into H.horridus.
scientific_limits.zh: 2022 Fig1B是据Scott与Jepsen的复原骨架，按胸部长度归一化，非绝对尺或已确认完整单标本。2011 Fig8标25厘米颅长但图注未具名号，不能擅定为SDSM3017/493。具名齿测量是独立标本。身体尺寸及耳皮毛尾色为复原估计，不混亚洲巨型种或现代鬣狗比例。

classification: Mammalia, Hyaenodonta, Hyaenodontidae; not Hyaenidae or modern Carnivora. Creodonta is historical grouping.

scale.model_status: Absolute living dimensions chosen estimates anchored loosely to published25cm skull; named canine measurements not claims same individual.

diagnostic_targets: Large long skull relative to torso, deep jaw behind long muzzle; not modern hyena short head or oversized sabrecat canine display.
Show enlarged blade-like shearing cheek teeth behind canines in modestly open mouth; teeth gate cannot vanish behind closed lips.
Long tapered muscular tail clearly distinct from short hyena tail.
Moderately elongated low torso and substantial semi-digitigrade limbs with differentiated wrist/hock, no tall slender wolf silhouette.
Small restrained ears and neutral inferred fur; no striped/spotted modern hyena coat or dramatic mane.
Complete original animal, not skull-only, preserve longhead/shearingteeth/longtail combination.
acceptance: Side view shows long tapered tail and proportionally large head; open mouth exposes at least clear blade-like postcanine teeth without extra render.
Four support limbs and joints coherent, avoid modern hyena slopingback stereotype.
Measurements and body estimates separated; fossil/photo/reconstruction source status accurate.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds and independent review.
